caption: Cascate del Mulino, Saturnia
composition: Thermal waterfalls over white travertine terraces into turquoise pools · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist looks down on the travertine terraces of the Cascate del Mulino, where steaming turquoise pools spill in white cascades over the crusty white rock. Bathers dot the upper pools at the center while waterfalls thread down the right, and the green valley and rounded hills roll behind. The 12:19 sun is high and hot under a clear blue sky, with steam drifting up from the thermal water.
